tax_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Corporales Muebles y la Prestación de Servicios (ITBMS)
legal_ref: Código Fiscal art. 1057-V, as amended by Ley 8 de 15 de marzo de 2010 (art. 76)
quote: "La tarifa de este impuesto será de (7%) a partir del 1 de julio del 2010. (art.76, Ley 8 del 2010)" — the tax rate is 7% from 1 July 2010
source_title: DGI Panamá – ITBMS Generalidades (dgi.mef.gob.pa); also https://dgi.mef.gob.pa/itbms/Itbms.php

reduced_rates.scope: higher rate: import and wholesale/retail sale of alcoholic beverages; lodging/accommodation services
higher rate: import and wholesale/retail sale of tobacco products
exempt (no ITBMS): medicines, basic school supplies, uniforms, textbooks, food, agricultural products, public utilities, medical and laboratory services

notes: Panama's 10% and 15% rates are higher, not reduced, rates. Registration/charging threshold: annual turnover above B/.36,000 (DGI). Rate was 5% before 1 July 2010.
unverified: Text of Ley 8 de 2010 art.76 not read in the Gaceta Oficial; rate/date taken from DGI page citing it
Prior 5% rate (before 1 July 2010) from search results only
